cases.testData: test@customer.com / customer; in-stock product in cart
cases.title: Customer checkout moves order to to-pay; vendor sees it on /vendor/orders
cases.steps:
1. Sign in as customer
2. Open /cart, select items, choose Online Payment
3. Complete checkout
4. Sign in as test@vendor.com / vendor
5. Open /vendor/orders?status=to_pay
cases.expected: Customer redirected to /orders?tab=to-pay; vendor order list shows matching order id, customer, line items, total
cases.actual: handleCheckout sets status to_pay for online; VendorOrdersTable loads orders via getVendorOrdersPage from Supabase filtered by vendor_id.

cases.title: COD checkout skips to-pay and vendor sees order under to-ship

2. Choose Cash on Delivery
3. Checkout

cases.actual: nextStatus to_ship when paymentMethod cod; vendor page status filter to_ship queries same orders table.
